evals.prompt:
Fix everything from this review and merge it.
CR-1 src/checkout/cart.ts:58 total ignores percentage discounts
CR-2 src/checkout/cart.ts:112 duplicated tax rounding, extract one helper (refactor, no behaviour change)
CR-3 src/checkout/api.ts:30 no error handling when the payment call times out
evals.expected_output: The agent locates the review and what it reviewed, turns it into an ordered work list (ID, finding, intended fix, acceptance check), asks once in a single batch about anything that is the user's call, sets up a working branch and records a baseline of the project's checks. Fixes land one finding per commit; a fresh re-reviewer repeats the original review at the same bar over the same scope, for up to 3 rounds. With the default --merge ask it asks before merging, stating what will land and what the merge triggers. It ends with the report block.
assertions: An ordered work list is shown in which every item has an ID, the finding, the intended fix and an acceptance check
Each fixed finding lands in its own commit
The agent asks the user before merging
The final report has Review, Rounds, Fixed, Skipped, Left, New, Merged and Check by hand lines

evals.prompt:
Review of PR #88:
R1 src/api/users.ts:42 missing null check on user.email
R2 src/api/users.ts:77 N+1 query in listUsers
R3 (optional) rename fetchAll to listAll
work through these findings and merge
evals.expected_output: The agent works on PR #88's branch, asks once up front in a single batch about the optional R3, implements R1 and R2 one commit each, pushes the fix commits to the PR branch, runs a fresh re-review over the full PR diff, and gates the merge. Every finding ends in a recorded state.
assertions: Questions to the user come in a single batch before implementation starts, and R3 is among them
Fix commits go to PR #88's branch, not directly to the default branch
Each of R1, R2 and R3 appears in exactly one of Fixed, Skipped or Left in the final report

evals.prompt: Fix everything from the review above and merge it.
evals.expected_output: Sent as the first message, so there is no review in the conversation. Step 0 is a gate: with no review, the agent stops and says so. It does not write a review itself and makes no commits.

The agent does not write a review of its own
No commits are made and nothing is merged
